# Modules that are INTENTIONALLY red, one Lake target per line.
#
# The breaker/builder discipline in AGENTS.md has a phase in which a frozen
# red battery exists and its implementation does not. During that phase the
# default build cannot be green, and a trust gate whose control step demands
# a green build cannot run at all.
#
# This file makes that phase explicit rather than letting the gate abort. It
# is self-checking in both directions: an undeclared failure fails the gate,
# and a declared module that is actually GREEN also fails the gate, so an
# entry cannot outlive the red phase it describes.
#
# Removing the last entry restores the original all-green control.
#
# P0: no entries. No packet was frozen yet.
#
# P3 queue-with-sizes and queuing strategies, frozen 2026-09-02 by the P3
# breaker seat. Packet: test/contracts/queue-with-sizes.contract.md.
# Implementation fence: Whatwg/Streams/Data/Queue.lean and
# Whatwg/Streams/Data/Strategy.lean. WhatwgTest.Streams.Data.QueueContract and
# WhatwgTest.Streams.Data.QueueAxiomReport were red here while the names they
# ascribe did not exist. The P3 builder seat landed that surface and removed
# the two entries; no entry remains.

# Q3b promise fidelity addendum, frozen RED 2026-09-07 by the Q3b addendum
# breaker seat on branch promise/q3b-breaker, based on f700230.
# Addendum: test/contracts/promise-first-packet-q3b.contract.md.
# Base packet: test/contracts/promise-first-packet.contract.md, whose text is
# unedited; the addendum is layered on it in the P5a "lifecycle and exact
# in-flight" shape.
# Graph: docs/PROMISE-DAG.md, "Q3b addendum".
# Attacks: test/counterexamples/promise/ATTACKS.md (WS-PROM-CE-023..038).
#
# It answers the six fidelity findings F1-F6 of ruling R-P20 and the minors
# that ruling lists. Both censuses stay all-absent and no coverage row moves.
#
# Implementation fence: Whatwg/Ecma262/{Promise,Jobs}.lean,
# Whatwg/WebIdl/Promise.lean, and one additive bridging lemma inside
# Whatwg/Streams/Writable/Laws.lean (settlementTrace_bridge), plus the two mask
# docstrings acceptance condition 5 names. No Streams definition body, no P4-P7
# theorem statement and no attribute [local simp] set may change.
# Whatwg/WebIdl/Exceptions.lean is untouched.
#
# NINE entries, in two classes.
#
# Class 1, the five new batteries. Each is red because the names it ascribes do
# not exist yet.
#
# Class 2, the four base-packet batteries that carry an amended ascription.
# Each is red because a Q3 ascription now names a signature or a right-hand
# side the landed implementation does not have. Every amended ascription
# carries a dated comment naming the addendum, the finding, the counterexample
# row and the superseded text, and nothing they checked was wrong:
#
#   WhatwgTest.Ecma262.PromiseContract   Reaction.mk, Reactions.add,
#                                        performPromiseThen
#   WhatwgTest.Ecma262.PromiseLaws       add_id, add_next, add_fulfill,
#                                        add_reject, add_paired,
#                                        settleAndTrigger_pending, and the
#                                        three performPromiseThen branches
#   WhatwgTest.WebIdl.PromiseContract    react, uponFulfillment, uponRejection,
#                                        react_pending, react_fulfilled,
#                                        react_rejected
#   WhatwgTest.Streams.PromiseBridge     subscribe_reactions_bridge
#
# WhatwgTest.Ecma262.JobsLaws and WhatwgTest.Ecma262.PromiseAxiomReport are
# NOT declared: the addendum changes only an annotation in the first and
# nothing in the second, so both stay green. The amendments change statements,
# never names, so the base packet's 125 receipts stay neither short nor long.
#
# WhatwgTest.Streams.PromiseBridge is red only at its one amended bridging
# ascription. Its preservation half is green today and acceptance condition 4
# of the addendum requires it to stay green: a repair that turns the module
# green by weakening a preservation ascription is a refusal, not a landing.
#
# The builder removes an entry the moment its battery is green.
#
# The Q3b builder seat landed the addendum on branch promise/q3b-builder in
# four moves: F5 in Whatwg/Ecma262/Jobs.lean; F1-F4 and the F6 trace in
# Whatwg/Ecma262/Promise.lean with the base packet's own Streams view and
# bridging lemma carrying the none result capability; F6 and the Web IDL
# minors in Whatwg/WebIdl/Promise.lean; and the one additive bridge
# Whatwg.Streams.Writable.settlementTrace_bridge inside
# Whatwg/Streams/Writable/Laws.lean with the two mask docstring corrections
# acceptance condition 5 names. All nine batteries are green and their nine
# entries are removed, so the trust gate's all-green control is restored.
#
# The 57 named receipts of WhatwgTest.Ecma262.PromiseFidelityAxiomReport all
# print inside the R-11 ceiling: 15 empty, 34 [propext], 6
# [propext, Quot.sound], 2 [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The base
# packet's 125 in WhatwgTest.Ecma262.PromiseAxiomReport are still exactly 125
# names with the same distribution as at the Q3 landing: 59 empty, 41
# [propext], 20 [propext, Quot.sound], 5
# [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. No entry remains.
